net_debt_note: net_debt carries the genuinely-broad / headline figure NOK 13,090mm (total debt 33,754 - cash & ST investments 20,664) so net_debt_basis:'broad' is truthful [01_price-and-capital-structure.md, Section 5 table, 'Net debt - broad / headline']. The report's CANONICAL net debt for its EV bridge and fair values is the cash-quality-adjusted figure NOK 17,919mm = 13,090 + NOK 1,390mm trapped captive-insurance cash (Industriforsikring AS) + NOK 3,439mm derivatives collateral, both disclosed by Hydro as unavailable to repay debt (labeled 'broad, ex-trapped balances', Section 5). Strict (debt - cash & equivalents only, excl. ST investments) is NOK 22,503mm. The schema net_debt_basis enum (strict/broad/gross-liquidity) cannot encode the ex-trapped adjustment, so 13,090mm is emitted under 'broad'; basis='equity' here means scenario levels are precomputed and this anchor is contextual, not used in a per-share bridge.
